subject: C23
required_fixes: C23-R4-F1 (medium): Validate the new saved-document recovery bindings before they authorize publication or cleanup. PersistedState::is_consistent (store.rs:224 onward) does not inspect open_imports. load_v1_receipts (authority/import_v1_domain.rs:317-328) then merges its entries directly into the authoritative receipt inventory, and recover (:1621-1641) automatically rolls them back. This bypasses receipt::load's schema/ID checks (import_v1/receipt.rs:335-346). A structurally valid saved document containing an unsupported receipt.schema is accepted; with its receipt files unavailable, that unsupported record is adopted, written back and used for owner rollback. A terminal receipt placed in open_imports is likewise accepted, despite this field's unsettled-only invariant, and can bypass staging. Validate the receipt schema/identity and open-binding invariants before merging, publishing or reverting it; unsupported/inconsistent bindings must fail closed. Acceptance: seed a normal interrupted import, make both receipt files unavailable and change the document copy to an unsupported schema or an invalid terminal binding. Relaunch through the production storage/core path: report corrupt/unsupported recovery metadata, preserve owner stores, and perform neither automatic cleanup nor publication based on that invalid binding. Valid current bindings must retain the demonstrated recovery behavior.
limitations: Independent read-only review. No application/source changes, build/test reruns, application launches, product endpoint calls or credential access. The remaining finding follows inspected serialization, consistency checks and recovery control flow; it is not claimed as a newly executed runtime reproduction. Only the designated verdict artifact is written.
